title: Recursive copy-machine states
statement: For each natural number $m$, define a state type recursively: at $m=0$ it is a singleton, at $m=1$ it consists of the three sweep phases, and at $m+2$ it is the disjoint union of the sweep phases, two copies of the seek phases, the state type at $m+1$, and two further copies of the seek phases.
